purpose: Predeclared cross-conversation 25-row gate for locked LOCOMO answer-side diagnostics; diagnostic only, not 199Q/cumulative.

conversation_selection.eligible_pool: all LOCOMO conversations in /tmp/locomo/data/locomo10.json except conv-26, requiring at least 2 rows per normalized category
conversation_selection.method: rank eligible conversations by sha256(seed + ":conv:" + sample_id); select first two conversations; split n as 13 and 12 before scoring

row_selection.method: Within each selected conversation/category, rank rows by sha256(seed + ":row:" + sample_id + ":" + one_based_index + ":" + question); take predeclared category quotas.

under_listing_watchpoint.definition: A row-53-class under-listing failure is a list-type question where the gold answer contains at least two enumerated entities and the treatment answer returns a strict subset of those gold entities that were present in the baseline answer or otherwise directly supported by the frozen context, with no compensating correction that makes the list complete.
under_listing_watchpoint.operational_screen: Flag questions containing list/count/plural enumeration cues or gold answers with comma/and-separated entities; compare baseline vs treatment predictions manually with gold/context support after the run.
under_listing_watchpoint.rollback_watchpoint: More than 2 such failures on this 25-row gate blocks 199Q promotion. For 199Q preregistration, list-completion regression budget remains <=2 row-53-class failures and <= -1pp aggregate list-completion impact.

thresholds.cross_conversation_gate: Proceed toward 199Q only if multi-hop treatment delta is >= +6pp absolute and row-53-class under-listing failures are <=2. If multi-hop comes in below +6pp, do not relax the threshold post hoc.
thresholds.199q_candidate_thresholds: Before any quote run, keep locked candidate fixed and predeclare +6pp absolute multi-hop threshold, <=2 row-53-class under-listing failures / about <=-1pp list-completion regression budget, and no adversarial/conflict claim unless separately tested.
